result:
The motion layer is on the title menu, the party window and 21 other windows. v29.82 is shipped, and the gate and the seed 4242 fingerprint (ents 85/374, containers 165/593) both passed.

The earlier runs had already shipped the layer on the title menu, the party window and the arcade board tab (v29.60). The pause card, end card, Settings and Keys joined it in v29.62. This run added the hub windows (v29.82):
- **Windows added:** trader, gamble, bar, looks, trophies, codex, board, news, sector, stage, carry, crate, ops, welcome and terms.
- **How they behave:** each opens over 240 ms with a 16 px rise and shuts in 140 ms. Each plays one open sound and one close sound.
- **New check:** for each of those windows it steps the clock and reads opacity at 0, 50 and 200 ms of an open. It then checks the open values clear after 600 ms. For the close it confirms the window is still showing straight after the close and gone within 150 ms. It also checks the open and close sounds log.

I left a few windows off on purpose, so they still open and close instantly: the confirm dialog, the dev, cheat and tuning windows, the sim window and the share window.

Still not done, and no run has measured any of them:
- the 4K frame-time check (I need a 4K stepping harness for it)
- the hover ring
- backdrop drift
- cursor parallax
- the glimmer sweep

I didn't take screenshots or run the critic, because this change is timing only. Notes are in `notes/11b-ui-motion.md`.

TASK PARTIAL: 4K frame-time measure, hover ring, backdrop drift, cursor parallax and glimmer sweep remain.
